verdict.rationale: Jev is a hosted model API, and the evidence explicitly says TypeSafe's own Jev weights are not published. The open 'Open-Jev' models are third-party reproductions, not TypeSafe source. A public GitHub README exists for an adapter repo, and the SDKs are distributed via package managers, but no item states an open license for any TypeSafe code, so an open-licensed source release of the product is unevidenced.
